recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes compartment semantics.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue asking to clarify that Medication is non-patient-specific even though patient medication lists are common, and to discuss resource compartment consequences on the compartments page.
initial_application: Jira's svn revision 6453 application maps to git commit 3be288e561fbfb7b91f0568b3db68023e53784b0, which added the Medication/Substance/Location non-compartment paragraph to the old compartments page. Commit 373b612eb89afded7ed828b553d4b058822f1659 later carried that paragraph into the current CompartmentDefinition notes source.
additional_context: Current source/compartments.xml lists Medication without compartment parameters while patient-linked medication resources have patient or subject parameters. Later Applied FHIR-51725 clarified that listed resources with .param entries are in a compartment and listed resources without .param entries are outside it, while still allowing servers to make outside resources available by _include or local convention; FHIR-51725 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was needed because current source already contains the requested Medication explanation and the authoritative compartment matrix already distinguishes Medication from MedicationAdministration and other patient-linked medication resources.

related_jiras.note: Clarifies modern compartment semantics and supports the no-change conclusion; already represented on the combined branch.
